tools.name: simpleswap_list_currencies
tools.description: List cryptocurrencies supported by SimpleSwap. Filter with query (ticker, network or name) and page with offset/limit. The full list has thousands of entries and each response is cut at about 20 000 characters regardless of limit: when truncated is true, call again with offset=nextOffset, or narrow

tools.name: simpleswap_list_pairs
tools.description: List the currencies a given currency can be exchanged to on SimpleSwap, for floating (default) or fixed rate. Identify the source by ticker and network (e.g. btc/btc); if the network is unknown, find it with simpleswap_list_currencies first. Use query to check one target currency. Page with offset/l

tools.name: simpleswap_get_range
tools.description: Get the minimum and maximum amount SimpleSwap accepts for a currency pair. Amounts are in the currency the user sends, or in the currency the user receives when reverse is true. reverse works only with fixed: true; never combine it with a floating rate. The range differs between fixed-rate and float

tools.name: simpleswap_get_estimate
tools.description: Estimate how much the user receives for an amount (or, with reverse, how much to send). reverse works only with fixed: true. Check the allowed amounts with simpleswap_get_range first. Fixed-rate estimates include rateId and validUntil.

tools.name: simpleswap_prepare_exchange
tools.description: Prepare an exchange for the user to finish on simpleswap.io: check the parameters and get a link to the SimpleSwap exchange form with the pair, networks, amount and rate type filled in. Safe to call: it creates no exchange, reserves no rate and has no side effects. When canCreate is true, show excha
